messages:
mika-sales: Quick thread : Prospect Zenith Capital wants BYO-KMS POC. Key asks: automated rotation demo, connector runtime pricing (prefer hourly), 7-day pen-test window, and perf target 8k QPS with p99 <150ms. Can we scope?
devin-se: We can demo rotation API if their KEK stays in their HSM. Need handshake spec + test vectors. Perf depends on prompt length; ask for seq len and concurrency distribution.
sam-crypto: Security constraints: no plaintext KEK leaving customer HSM; require wrapped test keys and signed thumbprints (sha256). Recommend rotation cadence demo: single rollover with 10-min cutover and 30-min grace/fallback.
tara-legal: Legal asks: explicit "no plaintext key export" warranty, audit-log retention (1 year), and pen-test liability cap. Also include rollback SLA credit cap and contact for incident notifications.
kai-eng-ops: For perf, earliest slot Thu 01:00-03:00 UTC. We can run 8k QPS for 10 mins if caches are primed. Need allowlist of our proxy IPs and a sample curl to validate TLS: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://kms-proxy.redwood.example.com/healthz`
mika-sales: Zenith prefers Fri evening for POC. Pricing: can we do connector runtime $120/hr for the POC and waive onboarding for enterprise?
devin-se: Connector runtime ok provisional. I'll confirm with finance. Also will draft perf checklist.
sam-crypto: I'll write minimal handshake spec: wrap-alg RSA-OAEP-256, thumbprint sha256 hex, signed nonce exchange, required audit fields.
tara-legal: I'll add SOW snippets: plaintext key prohibition, rotation rollback playbook, pen-test limited liability (cap = 1 month SLA credit or $20k), required HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2/3).
ops-bot: task-created: byo-kms-1767777777 (owner=kai-eng-ops) due=1767864177
kai-eng-ops: Booked tentative Fri slot. Need wrapped test-key bundle by EOD Wed to run preflight.
mika-sales: Action list: 1) I'll confirm Fri with Zenith, 2) Devin to get pricing firm, 3) Sam to share handshake doc, 4) Tara to draft SOW language, 5) Kai to run perf. I'll send combined pack to customer later today. :thumbsup:
